literal_meaning: নিশ্চিন্দিপুরে যাওয়া (to go to Nishchindipur, a proverbial place)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বুড়ো মানুষটি শেষে নিশ্চিন্দিপুর যাওয়ার পথে।
example_sentences_in_english: He went to Nishchindipur in the accident.
The old man is on his way to Nishchindipur.
note: Refers to a mythical place symbolizing death in Bengali folklore
